release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.40 fixes the Tasks regressions reproduced on v0.45.39 with the canonical v10 Tasks workspace. Boot now performs one automatic tree render only; the delayed 300 ms rebuild, 500 ms polling repaint loop, and runtime Tasks-tree MutationObserver stack are removed from the visible Tasks path. Login Cookies and ATC Cookies now open dedicated Tasks workspaces, while the legacy combined Target Session Jar Manager header and kind selector remain hidden behind the underlying local session runtime.
